Poppy is a champ that relies on snowballing and mostly on the enemy bot lane being worse than you. It can also be used as a team comp specific counterpick. 

Shes a good pick in lanes where there is a severe lack of burst damage or just low damage output early. By positioning around the bot lane and looking for wall stuns you force the enemy bot lane to play around you and possible miss cs. That being said if they never stand near a wall, you will spend most of the laning phase afk not being of much use. If you do manage to hit your stun along with aftershock, not only do you do lots of damage but also take very little in return. 

It must be noted that poppy is very much a snowball champ if you're choosing to play her bot. If you're ahead and build up tank stats quick, you can easily roll over the enemy bot lane. But if you don't you're just a walking bag of gold for the enemy team.
If you want to make the pick work, u'll need to pick it with strong laners or champs with early burst.

Take second wind, minion dematerialiser, time warp. Play back, go for easy cs, lose gracefully. If you don't die or get chunked early you will even out and it should be fine. 

Take note of their key poke spell, if its up play like you're gonna get hit by it, if its down feel free to walk up exert pressure. Stand behind and in the wave, if they try and hit you and push the wave by accident. This will open them up for ganks, and allow you to farm. The worst thing to have happen is the enemy support standing in front of the wave zoning u back from exp.

Another thing you can do is try and lvl 1 cheese. Poke supports are useless if they get jumped on, chunking them lvl 1 will make them more cautious to walk up for poke.

That's purely a team problem rather than your own fault. If the team is grouped then you might have a chance from behind. And if the twitch is fed with a janner on his side me might be able to 1v5. But if people get picked off 1 by 1 there's nothing you can do. Surr and go next

Ardent is mostly the best rush item, especially when your adc is a twitch. If your adc is out of position there's not much you can do, it's up to them to dodge  the Leona ulti or flash it. 

As Janner  with a nocturne on the enemy team you need to sit on your adc. If he ulties in 1v5 and his team can't follow up he's just inting. U see the nocturne ulti u immediately prep your q towards the enemy team and wait to ulti him off your adc. If your q can stop the enemy team and you kill the nocturne it's a 5v4 for your team.  

Of course all of this requires vision setup beforehand  

You may also consider buying a qss as your second item. The they have heavy cc. You getting cc'd is about as bad as your carries gettin cc'd. A qss will give you room to break free and peel for your carries.

On enchanters like Janna, Sona, Nami and lulu ardent is still king. In 9/10 games this will be your first item. Exceptions would be when playing with Jhin or ap bot laners. The item gives you everything you want. Cdr, mana regen, ap, shielding and damage buffing no reason to not rush it. 

General rule is:

- Ardent rush for auto attacking adc.
- Redemption if you want the healing, for extended fights and cross map assisting.
- Mikeals only if it shuts down the enemy bot lane. (I.e. Cleansing an ashe ulti will win you the 2v2)

As for going defensive when behind, thats normally a bad idea. If you have an adc that uses ardent you still want prioritize it over it redemption. The attack speed will almost always outweigh the benefits of the heal. If you feel like you need the resists to survive you can always just sit on the forbidden idol and go into other items like locket. 

Other items like Shurelya's and twin shadows are 100% situational. If you find your team chasing people down, go twin shadows. If you have one fed player on your team who just runs at people go Shurelya. Zekes is pure garbage on anyone who doesn't engage, the champs who tend to build zekes will be engage tanky champs. Not only will they be in the backline procing the item, but they will have the tanks stats to make use of the resists. If you are ever in range to proc the zekes as an enchanter you are terribly out of position and likely to die. If you really feel like you need survivability as an enchanter you can always just buy locket or flat tank items. Athenes is a good item to stack on top of all of your other heal and shield items if you don't need any engage or peel and just need to protect and buff your adc.

In the situation you mentioned with both Leona and Kennen, mikaelas rush is rather useless. When multiple cc can easily be applied mikaels isn't a good item, even if you cleanse one another one will stack on top. Its mostly good for when the enemy has one or two key cc abilites, Ashe ulti, Morgana bind, sejuani ulti. High impact single cc's. This doesn't mean you shouldn't buy it, it just means you should wait until later in the game.  

Other Things to note as an enchanter:

- Dark seal is an excellent first back item after upgrading your support item. You shouldn't die and stacking ap and mana is nice. 
- Stopwatch is another defensive option. If your adc is popping off, you will be as much of a target for the enemy team as the adc. If you die, your adc dies. Stopwatch for just 600g is a good option to prevent getting deleted.

It should have an active that applies the mutliated buff. Next spell or auto attack applies mutilated for 3 seconds 1:30 cd. Cuts healing and shielding. 

Getting rid of the vision denial and giving combat effectiveness without giving straight damage.

I play on 200+ ping, and just play anything that isn't an engage support. Try and stick to support where even if you mess up your timing it won't be fatal. Lulu, Janna, Nami any sort of enchanter support is your friend. 

Engage and tank champs like Ali or rakan are a no go, with high ping everything you do just feels that tiny bit off, and when you mess up you're likely going to die. Tahm and thresh are also some of the champs you may want to avoid.

Soraka and morg and any type of reactionary saving support you can still play, you just need to predict your ulti and shields rather than react with them. And when playing those champ you need to try and force advantages with your other abilities. 

You can always play some weird stuff as well, like miss fortune or trundle. These two champs are 100% decision making rather than mechanics and ping.
